title: Procedural Skies
description: An interactive 3D flight simulation and procedural terrain generation web application built with Three.js and Cannon-es, featuring dynamic multi-octave Perlin noise terrain chunking, real-time aerodynamic flight physics, and in-cockpit HUD instrumentation.
Highlights: Infinite procedural terrain chunk generation utilizing multi-octave 3D Perlin noise with dynamic elevation-based biome vertex coloring
Real-time 6DoF aerodynamic flight physics simulation powered by Cannon-es modeling lift, drag, engine thrust, and control surface torques
Interactive cockpit HUD instrumentation featuring dynamic throttle gauge, responsive attitude indicator (artificial horizon), and lil-gui configuration controls
Procedural world population system placing clustered natural assets (trees, rocks, clouds) with distance-based chunk pooling and garbage collection
Dynamic Web Audio API sound synthesis engine modulating aircraft engine frequency, pitch, and gain relative to throttle input
